# gsm_project_cluster_allocation_group (Data Source)

Reads a cluster allocation group owned by a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gsm_project_cluster_allocation_group" "default" {
  project_id                    = "<project_id>"
  cluster_allocation_group_name = "kr-default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_allocation_group_name` (String) Name of the cluster allocation group
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the cluster allocation group belongs

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels used to select this group during allocation
- `targets` (List of Object) Clusters that game servers are allocated from (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)

### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `tier` (Number)
- `weight` (Number)
